# Diagnostic codes

> **Audience:** deck authors, agents and contributors · **Generated from:** src/qa/codes.ts · **Version:** 0.2.0

`slidecraft check --json` and `build --json` report diagnostics with a stable `code`, a JSON `pointer` into deck.yaml, `measured` vs `limit` where relevant, and a `hint`. Exit codes: `0` ok (warnings allowed), `1` deck errors, `2` usage/internal error.

| Code | Severity | Meaning | Why | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SC-SPEC-001` | error | Deck does not match the schema | A field is missing, misspelled, has the wrong type or exceeds its declared capacity. | Read `slidecraft layouts --json` for the layout contract and correct the field at the pointer. |
| `SC-SPEC-002` | error | Unknown reference | A theme, storyline, layout, variant or source id does not exist. | Use an id from `slidecraft themes`, `slidecraft storylines`, `slidecraft layouts` or the deck `sources:` list. |
| `SC-SPEC-003` | error | Duplicate slide id | Slide ids must be unique so reviews and fixes can target one slide. | Give every slide a unique kebab-case `id`. |
| `SC-SPEC-004` | error | Included section file not found | A `- include: path.yaml` entry points to a missing or invalid file. | Check the path (relative to deck.yaml) and that the file contains a YAML list of slides. |
| `SC-FIT-001` | error | Text overflows its box | At the smallest allowed size the text still needs more lines than the box holds. SlideCraft never truncates. | Shorten the text by roughly the reported characters, split the point, or move detail to notes/backup. |
| `SC-FIT-002` | warning | Text shrunk below the preferred size | Copy-fitting stepped the font size down to make the text fit. | Optional: tighten the wording so the slide renders at the theme body size. |
| `SC-FIT-003` | error | Word too long for its box | A single word or token is wider than the column and would be split mid-word. | Hyphenate, abbreviate, or choose a layout with wider columns. |
| `SC-TITLE-001` | error | Action title runs past two lines | Titles are the argument of the deck; more than two lines stops them being skimmable. | Cut to one claim of ~8–14 words (under ~90 characters). |
| `SC-TITLE-002` | warning | Title reads like a topic, not a claim | Short noun phrases ("Market overview") state a subject but not the so-what. | Rewrite as a full sentence with a verb that states the takeaway (see action-title-writer skill). |
| `SC-TITLE-003` | warning | Title ends with punctuation | Consulting convention: action titles carry no trailing period. | Remove the trailing period. |
| `SC-SRC-001` | warning | Numbers without a source | The slide shows figures but cites no source. Every number must be traceable. | Add `sources: [id]` (from the deck `sources:` list) or a `source:` line. Mark illustrative data as such. |
| `SC-SRC-002` | error | Final deck has unsourced numbers | Decks with status `final` must cite every figure. | Add sources, or set status back to `review`. |
| `SC-GLYPH-001` | error | Font lacks glyphs for this text | The measuring font has no glyphs for some characters, so layout cannot be guaranteed. | Use a theme whose fonts cover the script, or set a `fonts.cyrillic` override in the theme. |
| `SC-GEOM-001` | error | Element outside the slide | A node extends beyond the page and would be clipped. | This is a layout bug — report it with the deck that triggers it. |
| `SC-GEOM-002` | warning | Content elements overlap | Two text or data elements intersect. | Reduce content so the layout can space it, or report a layout bug. |
| `SC-GEOM-003` | warning | Text spills out of its panel | Text starts inside a card, band or panel but its ink extends past the panel edge. | Shorten the text, reduce the number of items, or choose a layout with larger panels. |
| `SC-CONTRAST-001` | warning | Low text contrast | Text color against its background is below WCAG AA (4.5:1 body, 3:1 large). | Adjust the theme colors or the highlight choice. |
| `SC-DENSITY-001` | warning | Slide is dense | The slide carries more words than a reader can absorb in one pass. | Split into two slides or move detail into speaker notes. |
| `SC-STORY-001` | info | Storyline slot not covered | The chosen storyline expects a slide for this purpose and none was found. | Add the slide, or ignore if the slot does not apply to this deck. |
| `SC-PPTX-001` | error | Text missing from the PPTX | A string from the scene was not found in the written presentation XML. | This is an engine bug — report it with the deck that triggers it. |
| `SC-IMG-001` | warning | Image resolution too low | Effective resolution at its placed size is below 144 ppi; it will look soft when projected. | Supply a larger image or place it smaller. |
| `SC-IMG-002` | info | Image placeholder | An image slot has no image yet; a labelled placeholder was rendered. | Set `image: path/to/file.png` (relative to deck.yaml). |
| `SC-ENGINE-001` | warning | Engine unavailable, skipped | The requested engine is not installed or not detected on this machine. | Run `slidecraft doctor` for install hints, or choose another engine. |
